verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-operations capability, such as bulk user create/delete, bulk group membership updates, or Graph request batching. What it does document is adjacent: automatic SCIM provisioning sync, lifecycle workflows that run per user as each one moves through the lifecycle, and a Graph endpoint that only lists users. None of these is a user-invoked action applied to many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
